data.why: The app ships its own YAML scenario library under src/pediatric_asthma_ventilation_simulator/scenarios/ and needs no uploaded or synthetic data.

goals: Load and inspect a built-in ventilator scenario (e.g. safe_controlled_hypoventilation) and read its simulated auto-PEEP, plateau pressure and PaCO2 trajectory
Side-by-side compare two strategies, safe_controlled_hypoventilation vs high_rr_dynamic_hyperinflation, on trapped volume, auto-PEEP and MAP
Explore how respiratory rate, I:E ratio and obstruction severity drive dynamic hyperinflation and trapped volume via the sliders
View time-course charts of auto-PEEP, trapped volume, PaCO2 and mechanics curves across the simulated breaths
Export the simulated time-series or comparison-delta table as CSV for offline analysis
Use the teaching tab to connect the Te/tau_exp -> trapped volume -> auto-PEEP -> MAP causal chain to a concrete scenario's numbers

review.summary: The tree shows what the simulator is for: you load a preset, change ventilator and obstruction settings, compare two strategies, read the automatic teaching bullets and export. The features are mostly well cut, and the screens I sampled support the numbers. Before filing, it needs the stacked edits in t7 and t8 disclosed, an honest t5, and coverage of external PEEP, effort and preload, the other teaching presets, and the README's core causal chain.
